# Long-history P&L of a hierarchy node (stress window selection): pnl-history (PNLH)

Today's portfolio at one hierarchy node revalued over every business day of a long history (2007 to the day before the business date in the demo), one P&L per day in USD; the stress window selection values every 12-month window of it as a stressed VaR (VAR_GUIDE.md section 18.9). One row per hierarchy node per BUSINESS_DATE (the positions date), keyed by HISTORY_ID (PNLH-<NODE_ID>). Read by the **market-risk** pack's connector `risk-store` (table `<root>/risk/pnl-history/`). Delivered **per close of business**: one file per business date (`BUSINESS_DATE` 2026-09-30 in the test data), split into numbered parts when large; each date's file is the **full set** of that date (28 records), never a change on the day before.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/market-risk/pnl-history/` + `cob-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `HISTORY_ID` |
| Date field | `BUSINESS_DATE` (in every record: the business date it belongs to; the lake's partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `HIERARCHY`, `NODE_ID`, `LEVEL`, `CURRENCY`, `FIRST_DAY`, `LAST_DAY`, `DAY_COUNT` |
| Vector fields | `PNL` |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the full set of its date |

A real record, the most complete of the 28 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.


## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HISTORY_ID` | string | required | The record's id, PNLH-<NODE_ID> (the business key) | pattern `^PNLH-` | `"PNLH-LEGAL~BANK"` |
| `BUSINESS_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The positions date (YYYY-MM-DD), whose portfolio was revalued over the history. | — | `"2026-09-30"` |
| `HIERARCHY` | string | required | The hierarchy the node is in (MGMT, LEGAL in the demo): the tool's Hierarchy picker offers the hierarchies the date's rows name. | seen: `LEGAL`, `MGMT`; pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` | `"LEGAL"` |
| `NODE_ID` | string | required | The node, its id as the engine builds it (MGMT~BANK, MGMT~DESK-RATES, LEGAL~LE-NY). | pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*~`; links to `risk-hierarchy` | `"LEGAL~BANK"` |
| `NAME` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The node's name, as on the risk-hierarchy row. | — | `"Drishti Bank"` |
| `LEVEL` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The node's level: bank, division, legal-entity, desk (book rows are allowed; the demo sends none). | seen: `desk`, `legal-entity`, `bank`, `division` | `"bank"` |
| `CURRENCY` | string | required | The currency of PNL, ISO 4217: USD (the stress set's own currency). | one of `USD` | `"USD"` |
| `FIRST_DAY` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The first day of the history (YYYY-MM-DD), HISTORY_DATES' first. | — | `"2007-01-02"` |
| `LAST_DAY` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The last day of the history (YYYY-MM-DD), HISTORY_DATES' last; before BUSINESS_DATE. | — | `"2026-09-29"` |
| `DAY_COUNT` | integer | required | The number of days, the length of HISTORY_DATES and of PNL. | — | `4938` |
| `HISTORY_DATES` | array of dates | required | The days of the history, strictly increasing (YYYY-MM-DD), one per value of PNL. | — | [4938 values] |
| `PNL` | array of numbers | required | The node's P&L of today's portfolio under each day's market moves, in USD, gains positive, in HISTORY_DATES' order. A node's values are the sum of its children's. The days of the date's stress scenario set should carry the stress set's own P&L (so the configured window's figure is the node's stressed VaR), and the last days the normal set's. | unit: USD | [4938 numbers] |
| `SYNTHETIC` | boolean | optional (filled in every row) | True when the moves are not market history (the demo's); every answer of the tool says so. | — | `true` |
| `ANCHORS` | array of strings | optional (filled in every row) | The scenario sets whose days the history carries as they are (HS-STRESS-2008, HS-509 in the demo). Informational. | — | [2 values] |
| `SOURCE_BATCH` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The batch of the pricing system that produced the history. Informational. | — | `"B-2026-09-30-HIST"` |
| `DESCRIPTION` | string | optional (filled in every row) | What the history is, in words. | — | `"The long-history P&L of today's portfolio at this node, on…` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 28 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `HISTORY_ID` per `BUSINESS_DATE`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `HISTORY_ID`, `HIERARCHY`, `NODE_ID`, `CURRENCY`, `FIRST_DAY`, `LAST_DAY`, `DAY_COUNT`, `HISTORY_DATES`, `PNL`, `BUSINESS_DATE` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `NAME`, `LEVEL`, `SYNTHETIC`, `ANCHORS`, `SOURCE_BATCH`, `DESCRIPTION`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Each date: the full set of the date in one or more files, every record with its `BUSINESS_DATE`; a later full file of the same date restates it.
- Unique: `HISTORY_ID` per `BUSINESS_DATE`.
- `HISTORY_ID` matches `^PNLH-`.
